web/ — 05-todolist-web's browser-crossing rows (the rgh_host shape: a
pure declaration surface, bodies in the embedding Rust — wasm DOM/timer
doors on wasm32, the fake-DOM twin in tests). The registration scope IS
the package name (`web::*`); the use path spells it too.

The manifest-uniformity law folded this file into a pkg dir; it still
rides NO deps row anywhere — BOTH lanes register it by hand
(`register_web_surface` over the include_str!'d source, the
`mount_std_core` precedent), so the two-package law's count is
unchanged: the CONSUMER packages are biz and ui, and the host crossing
is bound, never mounted.
